title: Moonshot AI releases model weights for Kimi K3 under the "Kimi K3 License" (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Moonshot AI releases model weights for Kimi K3 under the “Kimi K3 License” — Moonshot AI has made its Kimi K3 model available for public download, expanding its reach and influence in the global open software community at a time of growing US concern about Chinese encroachment into the top echelons of AI development.
